data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Flights tab, origin and destination, date, Search, sort by Fastest, See flight, Select, Next) with the right parameters and order, but it adds a multi-city branch and a fare-choice step that are not clearly in the true actions and it is vague on passengers and filters, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
